visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a shot of three men outdoors in a sandy, fenced-off area. One man in a white t-shirt and another in a grey shirt are crouched over a patch of dirt, while a third man in a black t-shirt stands nearby. (2) A close-up reveals the man in the black t-shirt wearing glasses; he gestures and speaks toward the camera with a slightly strained expression. (3) The camera pans to a large, hand-built mud oven which has smoke billowing from beneath its lid. A silver metal plate sits on the ground next to it. (4) A young girl with her hair in pigtails is shown from the chest up, holding a large, fluffy white ball of cotton candy. She looks down at it with interest. (5) In a different scene, a toddler sits in a blue stroller, looking slightly tired while a hand offers them a small bowl of food. (6) Another young girl is shown sitting at a wooden picnic table, using yellow training chopsticks to eat from a bowl. She holds up three fingers to the camera. (7) A man holds up a single white sneaker to the lens, pointing out a small, circular burn hole on the side of the mesh fabric. (8) The climax of the visual narrative shows a golden-brown whole roast chicken being lifted out of the top of a mud oven using a metal hook and tray. Thick steam and smoke rise around it. (9) The roast chickens are placed on a wooden table alongside several roasted sweet potatoes on a silver tray. (10) The video concludes with a simple 2D animation of a boy and girl standing on a beige background with brand text below them.
